subject: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week — great to hear Nimbus is seeing steady growth across triage automation and patient routing. Based on the usage trends you shared we modeled a couple of uplift scenarios that should reduce unit cost and give you more headroom for Q3 traffic spikes.

Summary (proposal attached):
- Move from current 1.2M monthly token commit to a 2.5M commit (30% off unit baseline vs current pay-as-you-go).
- Introduce a new intermediate rate band between 2.5M–4.5M with soft-burst allowance for 10% monthly overage at reduced overage rate.
- Apply a short-term 6-month price lock with the option to annualize at renewal for additional discounts.

Attachments: Redwood_Nimbus_Upsell_SOW.pdf, ratesheet-q3-2028.xlsx

Next steps I suggest: 1) Quick sync to confirm commit cadence and PO timing; 2) Sign SOW (DocuSign) and we spin up the committed capacity and set soft-throttle thresholds; 3) Ops onboarding checklist for caching + batch tuning (we'll include CS).

Karthik — looping you for bandwidth and any special SLA asks. Marissa — can you confirm the onboarding window we should aim for if they sign this week?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@nimhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-19T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear options. 2.5M sounds reasonable as a first step — it aligns with our projected Q3 growth. A few quick clarifying questions before we proceed:

1) For the soft-burst allowance, is there a hard throttle after the 10% or do you have auto-fallback to a lower-cost model variant?
2) Can you confirm expected latency SLOs for the committed pool vs burst? We have a clinical SLA we need to honor (95th pctile < 120ms for inference).
3) PO timing — we generally need the signed SOW + PO within 10 business days for finance to process.

I'll loop in our contracts team to review the SOW and the ratesheet. If everything looks OK on pricing and SLOs, we'll aim to approve by next Thursday.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Integration, Nimbus Health
alex.chen@nimhealth.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-20T10:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health

Hi Alex,

Quick answers inline and adding ops notes below.

1) Soft-burst behavior: default is auto-fallback to the agreed overage tier at the reduced overage rate — we avoid hard throttles for clinical traffic. We can add model-variant fallback as an optional guardrail for non-critical endpoints to preserve capacity for clinical inference.

2) Latency SLOs: committed pool (pinned dedicated slices) targets 95th < 90ms for standard gen workloads at median payloads; burst paths are best-effort but we can attach a regional priority and warm KV caches to keep 95th < 120ms. I'll have implementation notes in the Ops onboarding doc.

3) PO timing: 10 business days works — we can provision reserved capacity after signed SOW but prior to invoicing if you push PO quickly; we'll need finance sign-off for a mid-month activation.

Ops & onboarding: Marissa — proposed activation window is 5 business days from SOW signature for a staged capacity spin-up (initial dedicated pool + warm cache + batch tuning). Please confirm availability.

Alex — I'll drop a DocuSign envelope after legal review and include the PO template you can pass to finance.

Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health

Sofia / Karthik — confirmed. Ops slot available the week of 3/27. Staged activation plan:
- Day 0: SOW signed + PO received -> reserve capacity queue (we allocate GPU pool and reserve KV cache budget)
- Day 1–2: Provision dedicated pool in us-west-2, enable priority routing and warm up top-50 prefixes (Nim-specific prompts)
- Day 3–4: Run load validation (simulated traffic), finalize soft-burst thresholds and alerting in Console
- Day 5: Go-live; monitor 24–72 hours and run follow-up tuning for batching/quantization profiles

Two asks for contracts: 1) Include a clause describing emergency throttle/fallback policy (we recommend model-variant fallback only for non-clinical endpoints), 2) Confirm invoice cadence and whether Nimbus prefers monthly or net-30 with consolidated monthly invoice.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimhealth.com>
To: Contracts Team <contracts@nimhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: Hosted API commit uplift + rate remap for Nimbus Health

All — Contracts reviewed the SOW and pushed back on two small redlines (requested edits attached). They confirmed PO will be submitted once a final SOW is returned. Regarding invoicing: Nimbus prefers net-30 consolidated monthly invoicing.

We accept the 2.5M commit with the intermediate rate band and 10% soft-burst allowance; we also accept priority routing for clinical endpoints as long as the 95th < 120ms clause is explicitly stated for the clinical endpoints.

I'll sign the DocuSign after the legal edits are incorporated. Please return an updated SOW and I will route to finance for PO.

Thanks,
Alex
